naam: Voeten naast elkaar staan – met steun
beginhouding_nl: Rechtop staan, voeten op heupbreedte, één hand op de stoelleuning.
pijl_nl: Geen pijl (statische stand).
pose_en: Three-quarter front view. Static balance stance: she stands upright with both feet together, side by side and touching, arms relaxed. There is NO arrow anywhere in the image. One hand rests lightly on the backrest of a simple chair beside her.

naam: Voeten naast elkaar staan – zonder steun
beginhouding_nl: Rechtop staan zonder steun, voeten op heupbreedte, armen langs het lichaam.
pijl_nl: Geen pijl (statische stand).
pose_en: Front view. Static balance stance: she stands upright with both feet together, side by side and touching, arms relaxed. There is NO arrow anywhere in the image.

naam: Voeten naast elkaar staan – met hoofdbeweging
bron_titel: Feet together balance head turns (Balance, standing, turning head, feet together)
beginhouding_nl: Rechtop staan met de voeten tegen elkaar, armen langs het lichaam, kijkend naar voren.
pijl_nl: Hoofd draait naar links en naar rechts.
pose_en: Front view of a person standing upright with feet close together, touching, arms relaxed by the sides, head facing forward. Both feet are clearly visible, flat on the floor. One solid black arrow: a double-headed curved arrow arching horizontally just above the head, from one ear around the front of the face to the other ear, showing the head turning left and right.

bron_titel: Semi-tandem foot balance (Balance, tandem semi stance)
beginhouding_nl: Rechtop achter een stoel, beide handen op de leuning, voeten naast elkaar.
pijl_nl: Ene voet stapt een halve voetlengte naar voren, hak naast de voetboog van de andere voet.
pose_en: Three-quarter front view of a person standing upright behind a plain wooden chair, both hands resting on the top of the chair backrest, feet side by side and slightly apart. Both feet are clearly visible below the chair seat, not hidden by the chair legs. One short curved solid black arrow starts at the toes of the right foot and curves forward and slightly inward, ending half a foot length ahead, next to the arch of the left foot.

beginhouding_nl: Rechtop staan zonder steun, voeten naast elkaar, armen langs het lichaam.
pijl_nl: Ene voet stapt een halve voetlengte naar voren, hak naast de voetboog van de andere voet.
pose_en: Three-quarter front view of a person standing upright without support, feet side by side and slightly apart, arms relaxed by the sides. Both feet are clearly visible, flat on the floor. One short curved solid black arrow starts at the toes of the right foot and curves forward and slightly inward, ending half a foot length ahead, next to the arch of the left foot.

bron_titel: Semi-tandem foot balance (Balance, tandem semi stance)
beginhouding_nl: Rechtop in semi-tandemstand: ene voet een halve voetlengte voor de andere, armen langs het lichaam.
pijl_nl: Hoofd draait naar links en naar rechts.
pose_en: Three-quarter front view of a person standing upright in semi-tandem stance: the right foot half a foot length in front of the left, its heel beside the arch of the left foot, arms relaxed by the sides, head facing forward. Both feet are clearly visible, flat on the floor. One solid black arrow: a double-headed curved arrow arching horizontally just above the head, from one ear around the front of the face to the other ear, showing the head turning left and right.

beginhouding_nl: Rechtop staan zonder steun, voeten naast elkaar, armen langs het lichaam.
pijl_nl: Achterste voet stapt recht voor de andere voet, hak tegen de tenen.
pose_en: Three-quarter front view of a person standing upright without support, feet side by side and slightly apart, arms relaxed by the sides, looking ahead. Both feet are clearly visible, flat on the floor. One short curved solid black arrow starts at the toes of the right foot and curves forward and inward, ending directly in front of the toes of the left foot, on the same line, showing heel-to-toe placement.

bron_titel: Tandem with head turns (Balance, tandem stance, turning head, arms out to side, beside chair)
beginhouding_nl: Rechtop in tandemstand: ene voet recht voor de andere, hak tegen de tenen.
pijl_nl: Hoofd draait naar links en naar rechts.
pose_en: Three-quarter front view of a person standing upright in tandem stance, the right foot placed directly in front of the left foot so the right heel touches the left toes, arms relaxed by the sides, head facing forward. Both feet are clearly visible, flat on the floor. One solid black arrow: a double-headed curved arrow arching horizontally just above the head, from one ear around the front of the face to the other ear, showing the head turning left and right.

beginhouding_nl: Rechtop naast een stoel, één hand op de leuning, beide voeten op de grond.
pijl_nl: Voet aan de kant weg van de stoel komt los van de grond.
pose_en: Side view of a person standing upright on both feet next to a plain wooden chair placed beside the figure, one hand resting on the top of the chair backrest, the other arm relaxed by the side. Both feet are clearly visible, flat on the floor. One short solid black arrow starts just behind the heel of the leg farthest from the chair and curves upward and backward, showing that foot lifting off the floor with a bent knee.
extra_en: CORRECTION: start position: she stands upright on BOTH feet, both feet flat on the floor, NO leg or knee raised yet. One short curved arrow starts at the front of one knee and points up, showing that knee/foot being lifted.

beginhouding_nl: Rechtop staan zonder steun, beide voeten op de grond, armen langs het lichaam.
pijl_nl: Ene voet komt los van de grond.
pose_en: Side view of a person standing upright without support on both feet, arms relaxed by the sides, looking ahead. Both feet are clearly visible, flat on the floor. One short solid black arrow starts just behind the heel of the near leg and curves upward and backward, showing that foot lifting off the floor with a bent knee.
extra_en: CORRECTION: start position: she stands upright on BOTH feet, both feet flat on the floor, NO leg or knee raised yet. One short curved arrow starts at the front of one knee and points up, showing that knee/foot being lifted.

beginhouding_nl: Rechtop op één been, andere voet net los van de grond, armen langs het lichaam.
pijl_nl: Hoofd draait naar links en naar rechts.
pose_en: Three-quarter front view of a person standing upright on the left leg, the right foot lifted a few centimetres off the floor with the knee slightly bent, arms relaxed by the sides, head facing forward. Both feet are clearly visible. One solid black arrow: a double-headed curved arrow arching horizontally just above the head, from one ear around the front of the face to the other ear, showing the head turning left and right.

beginhouding_nl: Rechtop achter een stoel, handen op de leuning, voeten plat op heupbreedte.
pijl_nl: Lichaam leunt als geheel naar voren richting de tenen.
pose_en: Side view of a person standing upright behind a plain wooden chair, both hands resting on the top of the chair backrest, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart. Both feet are clearly visible. One solid black arrow starts at the front of the hips and points horizontally forward toward the chair, showing the body weight moving forward over the toes while the feet stay flat.

beginhouding_nl: Rechtop staan zonder steun, voeten plat op heupbreedte, armen langs het lichaam.
pijl_nl: Lichaam leunt als geheel naar voren richting de tenen.
pose_en: Side view of a person standing upright without support, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, arms relaxed by the sides. Both feet are clearly visible, flat on the floor. One solid black arrow starts at the front of the hips and points horizontally forward, showing the body weight moving forward over the toes while the feet stay flat.

bron_titel: Weight shifting side-to-side close to support
beginhouding_nl: Rechtop achter een stoel, handen op de leuning, voeten op heupbreedte.
pijl_nl: Heupen schuiven opzij boven het ene been.
pose_en: Front view of a person standing upright behind a plain wooden chair, both hands resting on the top of the chair backrest, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart. Both feet are clearly visible below the chair seat. One solid black arrow starts at the side of the right hip and points horizontally outward to the right, showing the hips and body weight shifting over the right leg.

beginhouding_nl: Rechtop staan zonder steun, voeten plat op heupbreedte, armen langs het lichaam.
pijl_nl: Heupen schuiven opzij boven het ene been.
pose_en: Front view of a person standing upright without support, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, arms relaxed by the sides. Both feet are clearly visible, flat on the floor. One solid black arrow starts at the side of the right hip and points horizontally outward to the right, showing the hips and body weight shifting over the right leg.

beginhouding_nl: Rechtop naast een stoel, ene hand op de leuning, andere arm gestrekt naar voren op schouderhoogte.
pijl_nl: Gestrekte arm reikt verder naar voren.
pose_en: Side view of a person standing upright with feet hip-width apart next to a plain wooden chair placed beside the figure, one hand resting on the top of the chair backrest; the other arm is raised straight forward at shoulder height. Both feet are clearly visible, flat on the floor. One solid black arrow starts at the fingertips of the raised hand and points horizontally forward, showing the arm reaching further forward.
extra_en: CORRECTION, start position: she stands upright with BOTH arms hanging relaxed by her sides, NO arm raised yet. One curved arrow starts at the hand of one arm and sweeps forward and up to shoulder height and further forward, showing the arm reaching forward. Her other hand (the hand nearest the chair) rests on top of the chair backrest for support; the reaching arm is the arm away from the chair.

beginhouding_nl: Rechtop staan zonder steun, voeten op heupbreedte, één arm gestrekt naar voren op schouderhoogte.
pijl_nl: Gestrekte arm reikt verder naar voren.
pose_en: Side view of a person standing upright without support, feet hip-width apart, the near arm raised straight forward at shoulder height, the other arm relaxed by the side. Both feet are clearly visible, flat on the floor. One solid black arrow starts at the fingertips of the raised hand and points horizontally forward, showing the arm reaching further forward.
extra_en: CORRECTION, start position: she stands upright with BOTH arms hanging relaxed by her sides, NO arm raised yet. One curved arrow starts at the hand of one arm and sweeps forward and up to shoulder height and further forward, showing the arm reaching forward.

naam: Op de plaats marcheren – met steun
bron_titel: Marching on spot - close to a stable surface
beginhouding_nl: Rechtop achter een stoel, handen op de leuning, voeten naast elkaar.
pijl_nl: Ene knie gaat omhoog richting heuphoogte.
pose_en: Side view of a person standing upright behind a plain wooden chair, both hands resting on the top of the chair backrest, feet side by side flat on the floor. Both feet are clearly visible. One curved solid black arrow starts at the front of the near knee and curves forward and upward to hip height, showing the knee lifting.
extra_en: CORRECTION: start position: she stands upright on BOTH feet, both feet flat on the floor, NO leg or knee raised yet. One short curved arrow starts at the front of one knee and points up, showing that knee/foot being lifted.

naam: Op de plaats marcheren – zonder steun
beginhouding_nl: Rechtop staan zonder steun, voeten naast elkaar, armen langs het lichaam.
pijl_nl: Ene knie gaat omhoog richting heuphoogte.
pose_en: Side view of a person standing upright without support, feet side by side, arms relaxed by the sides. Both feet are clearly visible, flat on the floor. One curved solid black arrow starts at the front of the near knee and curves forward and upward to hip height, showing the knee lifting.
extra_en: CORRECTION: start position: she stands upright on BOTH feet, both feet flat on the floor, NO leg or knee raised yet. One short curved arrow starts at the front of one knee and points up, showing that knee/foot being lifted.

beginhouding_nl: Rechtop met het gezicht naar een tafel, handen op het tafelblad, voeten naast elkaar.
pijl_nl: Ene voet stapt opzij langs de tafel.
pose_en: Front view of a person standing upright behind a plain table, facing the viewer across it, both hands resting on the tabletop, feet side by side. Both feet are clearly visible below the table, not hidden by the table legs. One solid black arrow starts at the outer side of the right foot and points horizontally sideways to the right along the floor, showing a side step.

beginhouding_nl: Rechtop staan zonder steun, voeten naast elkaar, armen langs het lichaam.
pijl_nl: Ene voet stapt opzij.
pose_en: Front view of a person standing upright without support, feet side by side, arms relaxed by the sides. Both feet are clearly visible, flat on the floor. One solid black arrow starts at the outer side of the right foot and points horizontally sideways to the right along the floor, showing a side step.

beginhouding_nl: Rechtop naast een tafel, één hand op het tafelblad, voeten naast elkaar.
pijl_nl: Ene voet stapt naar achteren.
pose_en: Side view of a person standing upright next to a plain table, the near hand resting on the tabletop, the other arm relaxed, feet side by side. Both feet are clearly visible and not hidden by the table legs. One curved solid black arrow starts at the heel of the far-from-table foot and curves backward along the floor, ending one step length behind the body, showing a step backward.
extra_en: CORRECTION: strict side profile, she faces RIGHT with one hand on a table beside her; the arrow starts at the heel of her rear foot and points to the LEFT, BACKWARD, behind her (she steps backward, opposite to where she is looking).

bron_titel: Backwards walking (Balance, walking backward, toes touching first - slow)
beginhouding_nl: Rechtop staan zonder steun, voeten naast elkaar, kijkend naar voren.
pijl_nl: Ene voet stapt naar achteren.
pose_en: Side view of a person standing upright without support, feet side by side, arms relaxed by the sides, looking ahead. Both feet are clearly visible, flat on the floor. One curved solid black arrow starts at the heel of the near foot and curves backward along the floor, ending one step length behind the body, showing a step backward.

naam: Over een obstakel stappen – met steun
beginhouding_nl: Rechtop naast een stoel, één hand op de leuning, voor een opgerolde handdoek op de grond.
pijl_nl: Voorste voet stapt in een boog over de handdoek.
pose_en: Side view of a person standing upright with feet side by side next to a plain wooden chair placed beside the figure, one hand resting on the top of the chair backrest, the other arm relaxed; a low rolled-up towel lies on the floor just in front of the toes. Both feet and the towel are clearly visible. One curved solid black arrow starts at the toes of the near foot, arches up over the towel and ends on the floor beyond it, showing the step over the obstacle.

naam: Over een obstakel stappen – zonder steun
beginhouding_nl: Rechtop staan zonder steun voor een opgerolde handdoek op de grond.
pijl_nl: Voorste voet stapt in een boog over de handdoek.
pose_en: Side view of a person standing upright without support, feet side by side, arms relaxed by the sides; a low rolled-up towel lies on the floor just in front of the toes. Both feet and the towel are clearly visible. One curved solid black arrow starts at the toes of the near foot, arches up over the towel and ends on the floor beyond it, showing the step over the obstacle.

naam: Draaien op de plaats – met steun
beginhouding_nl: Rechtop achter een stoel, handen op de leuning, voeten op heupbreedte.
pijl_nl: Kleine stapjes in een rondje om de eigen as.
pose_en: Three-quarter front view of a person standing upright behind a plain wooden chair, both hands resting on the top of the chair backrest, feet hip-width apart. Both feet are clearly visible below the chair seat. One large curved solid black arrow circles horizontally around the feet at ankle height, almost a full circle, showing the body turning on the spot.

naam: Draaien op de plaats – zonder steun
beginhouding_nl: Rechtop staan zonder steun, voeten op heupbreedte, armen langs het lichaam.
pijl_nl: Kleine stapjes in een rondje om de eigen as.
pose_en: Three-quarter front view of a person standing upright without support, feet hip-width apart, arms relaxed by the sides. Both feet are clearly visible, flat on the floor. One large curved solid black arrow circles horizontally around the feet at ankle height, almost a full circle, showing the body turning on the spot.

naam: Stoel opstaan en lopen – zonder steun
bron_titel: Timed up and go ("Timed up and go TUG" Gait balance/mobility)
beginhouding_nl: Rechtop zittend op een stoel, voeten plat op de grond, handen op de bovenbenen.
pijl_nl: Lichaam komt naar voren en omhoog tot staan.
pose_en: Side view of a person sitting upright on a plain wooden chair, feet flat on the floor, hands resting on the thighs, not using the armrests. Both feet are clearly visible. One curved solid black arrow starts at the chest and curves forward and upward over the knees, showing the body rising to standing.
extra_en: CORRECTION, start position: side view, she sits fully UPRIGHT on the chair: trunk vertical, back straight, shoulders above the hips, NOT leaning forward, hands on her thighs, feet flat. One curved arrow starts at her chest and sweeps forward and then up, showing standing up and walking forward.

naam: Dubbele taak lopen – met cognitieve taak
bron_titel: Timed up and go (cognitive task: counting) ("Timed up and go TUG" Gait balance/mobility, with cognitive task, counting backwards)
beginhouding_nl: Rechtop staan, voeten naast elkaar, armen langs het lichaam, kijkend naar voren.
pijl_nl: Ene voet stapt naar voren om te gaan lopen.
pose_en: Side view of a person standing upright, feet side by side, arms relaxed by the sides, looking ahead with mouth slightly open as if speaking. Both feet are clearly visible, flat on the floor. One curved solid black arrow starts at the toes of the near foot and curves forward along the floor, ending one step length ahead, showing the first step of walking.
extra_en: CORRECTION: strict side profile, she faces RIGHT and looks to the right; the arrow on the floor starts at her front foot and points to the RIGHT, forward in the direction she is looking and walking.
